text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after training, Hishi Akebono
visits me
in my office.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hi there, Trainer! Are you busy right
now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Today's Valentine's Day, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have a super buono present just
for you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's ready now, so come with me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her until we end up at the
cafeteria, which
smells heavenly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a flourish, Hishi Akebono steps
back...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And reveals a chocolate cake of epic
proportions!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to think of a way to show
you my
gratitude, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And I realized the best way to do it was
to put my
feelings into physical form!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I poured all my feelings of gratitude
into the
cake while I was baking it, and
it turned out
super-duper big!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But that's okay, because bigger is
better!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here you go, enjoy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She serves me a slice, and I take a bite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate cake is so delicious I
almost feel as
if I've been physically
struck when I have my first
mouthful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Yay! That's good to hear.
Actually, I went a
little easy on the
sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I did something special to every layer of
sponge,
too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The top layer has cookies in it, the
second one is
filled with walnuts and
peanuts, and the bottom
layer is a
fruit-fest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to enjoy every last bite,
without
ever getting tired of the taste!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nothing would make me happier than if
you ate
to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was afraid this cake was too big at first,
but
since it's packed full of big feelings,
I really want
to make sure I finish the
whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lose myself in the cake for a while, but
then I
start thinking about what my next
few weeks will
look like with all this
chocolate cake...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the cake will freeze well, so you
don't have to
worry about finishing it all
at once! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I end up having a memorably
pleasant
day with Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And reveals an earthenware pot full of
bubbling
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I made you chocolate chanko!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, I say "chanko," but there won't be
any
veggies in there! I only prepared
fruits, so you can
relax!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I didn't put them in yet because I didn't
want the
fruit to overcook, so I'll just
add them now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono starts carefully cooking
tons of
beautifully cut fruit in the pot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There, all done! ☆ There's a lot left, so
eat as
much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She serves me a bowl of fruit and I waste
no time
taking a sip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate chanko is so buono I
almost feel as
if I've been physically
struck when I have my first
mouthful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, at first I was just going to
make you
regular chocolate, but it didn't
feel quite right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're a really special person to me, so I
wanted
to make you something really
special.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's right! But actually, the
chanko isn't
complete yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the pot before me, I'm not
sure what
else she could possibly add.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Did you know? Chanko is tastiest
when you
eat it with other people.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the experience makes you feel
all warm
and fuzzy and ready to work
hard again!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Um... would it be all right if I joined you,
so we
can eat it together?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Okay! Let's work hard together,
Trainer!
Woo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We indulge in the chocolate chanko
together as
we chat about all that's
happened, as well as what
we're going
to do in the future.
